pmid:39671723.reason: Sericin plus hydroxychloroquine in DEN-induced mouse lung carcinogenesis; in vivo only.

pmid:39624248.reason: Single-arm phase II regorafenib plus oral methotrexate in KRAS-mutant NSCLC; missed primary endpoint, toxic.

pmid:39499771.reason: Maprotiline lowers PD-L1 via SPOP, in vivo synergy with anti-CTLA4; mostly colorectal/network-based.

pmid:39332188.reason: Pazopanib plus metformin in urethane-induced lung cancer mice; in vivo preclinical.

pmid:39245263.reason: Letrozole/omega-3 PUFA sensitises NSCLC immune-xenografts to pembrolizumab; preclinical.

pmid:39135791.reason: Three-hospital retrospective cohort (n=516 ICI patients, 76 on metformin): metformin tied to better OS/PFS in lung subgroup; small, confounding.

pmid:39111630.reason: Disulfiram/copper plus adavosertib in p53-deficient NSCLC xenografts; in vivo preclinical.

pmid:39054566.reason: Auranofin plus sorafenib in SCLC cells with xenograft data; preclinical.

pmid:39040065.reason: Metformin Mn-nanocarrier plus PD-1 inhibitor reduces tumour growth in vivo; preclinical.
